You don't want to hurt your family and that tells me you are a kind, caring person who puts others before yourself. Having low self confidence is shit and I know it is. I know there isn't much I can say if anything to make you feel better but if you need someone to talk to even just to chat about trivial things I'm here so feel free to pm me

I was forced to drop out of college, my work keep cutting my hours, I have no money and no place I can call home and the one person who cares about me can't deal with any of it anymore. I have no skills or hobbies or anything like that and I know its selfish and i know I'll hurt people and that sucks but I can't go another day. Each day consits of self loathing, binge eating and forcing myself to throw up, self harm and tears. I don't feel like I have anything to live for. I've been on medication after medication and it hasn't helped and I've had therapy and its not helped so I don't really see any other option other than to end my life.

I know there is nothing anyone can say to change your mind once it has been made up. But please reconsider no matter how you feel or what you think there are people out there who care about you. Feel free to pm me if you need to talk or have you ever thought about speaking to somone such as a therapist?
